html:
The last stretch of the road is about running a trained transformer well, and a capstone that walks the whole planet in one place.

Topics on this stretch of the road:

  • Inference Serving Trade-offs: batching, latency and throughput when serving a transformer to real traffic.
  • Capstone: Assembling a Tiny Transformer from the Ground Up: one small project, tracing every piece this planet covered through a single forward pass.
